headline: Custom solid wood furniture, born from the projects we love.
body1: While designing and executing spaces for our clients, we became so absorbed in the character of solid wood that we began crafting bespoke loose furniture to complete them. Unikraft is that obsession, formalised.
body2: Every piece is custom-designed, solid wood, and made in India. Blue Door clients have direct access to Unikraft — the furniture conceived alongside the space it lives in.
collection_desc: A debut collection of custom solid wood loose furniture — designed with oblique angles, honest materials, and the quiet confidence of things made to last.
